content.text:
I removed the rule that at least one unit of each resource must stay unallocated. I didn't run any checks.

- A request now fails only if it exceeds the remaining capacity, so using a resource's full capacity is valid.
- I deleted the final check that returned `False` when any resource had less than 1 unit left.
- I also updated the docstring to match.

Input validation, cumulative tracking and the original function signature are unchanged. The inputs are still not mutated, because the function works on a copy of `resources`.
